text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of her debut, Mejiro Palmer decides to make herself look as much like a party girl as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, seeing the fans who have supported the Mejiro family for years at the venue, she becomes intimidated and the race turns awkward.
